name: Oogie Boogie Bash - A Disney Halloween Party
summary: The 2026 party runs on 33 select nights at Disney California Adventure. General admission is sold out as of September 26; Disney says D23-member tickets remain for September 27. Existing ticket holders get the five-hour party plus admission from 3 p.m.
h1: Oogie Boogie Bash: what the ticket buys, what it costs, and how to actually get one
title: Oogie Boogie Bash
description: 2026 Oogie Boogie Bash dates, $139–$199 ticket prices, sold-out status, 3 p.m. entry, and the new Madame Leota street party.

typicalWindow.hours: 2026 party nights: 6:00–11:00 p.m.; the event ticket admits guests to Disney California Adventure from 3:00 p.m.

pricing.cheapestNights: Select August and September nights at $139; availability is no longer general-sale as of September 26, 2026
pricing.priciestNights: Halloween night, October 31, at $199 on Disney’s published 2026 date list
notes: Disney’s 2026 published prices range from $139 to $199 by event date; check the official page for any changes.
General admission is sold out as of September 26, 2026. Disney currently directs eligible D23 members to remaining September 27 tickets.
The event ticket admits you to Disney California Adventure from 3:00 p.m.; a separate park reservation is not needed for entry at 3:00 p.m. or later.
Parking is not included. Lightning Lane Multi Pass, Premier Pass and Single Pass are unavailable during the party.

whatYouGet: Admission to Disney California Adventure from 3:00 p.m. on the ticketed date, with the party running 6:00–11:00 p.m.
Themed treat trails with Disney villains, plus separate seasonal character encounters.
Madame Leota’s Swinging Wake – A Haunted Mansion Street Party, new for 2026.
Villains Grove at Redwood Creek Challenge Trail.
Access to select attractions, including the Halloween versions of Guardians of the Galaxy, Mater’s and Luigi’s rides.
Unlimited Disney PhotoPass digital downloads of photos captured during party hours, subject to Disney’s terms.
Costumes for adults and children under Disney’s event costume rules.
whatYouDont: A generally available ticket: Disney says 2026 general admission is sold out as of September 26. The September 27 D23-member night is the stated exception.
Admission to Disneyland Park. The event ticket covers Disney California Adventure only.
A Lightning Lane pass during event hours; Multi Pass, Premier Pass and Single Pass are unavailable then.
Every attraction or experience. Disney says offerings may change and only select attractions operate.
The dessert party. It requires a separate reservation and charge in addition to a same-night Bash ticket.
Parking, which Disney says is not included in the event ticket.

verdict.short: The 2026 party offers early entry, treat trails, Villains Grove and Madame Leota’s street party. General admission is sold out as of September 26.
worthItIf: You care about villain characters and photographs with them more than about ride count.
Someone in your group wants to wear a costume, because this is the only night at Disney California Adventure when adults can.
You already hold a valid ticket for your date, or qualify for the September 27 D23-member night while Disney still lists it as available.
You want Villains Grove, themed treat trails and Madame Leota’s 2026 street party.
You have done Disney California Adventure before and want a version of it you have not seen.
skipIf: You do not hold a ticket. Disney lists general admission as sold out, so do not build a trip around an unavailable event night.
Your priority is riding as much as possible. A regular evening at Disney California Adventure in mid-September gives you more attractions per hour for a fraction of the money.
Your group includes a young child who fades by eight in the evening. The party's best two hours are its last two.
You want to see both parks that day. The ticket does not do that, and a mid-afternoon entry leaves no room for a Disneyland Park morning unless you buy a second ticket.
You resent paying twice for the same park. The party ticket does not extend a regular day, it replaces the evening of one.

strategy.heading: For 2026, check the ticket status before planning
body: Disney lists 2026 general admission as sold out as of September 26. Its event page says tickets for the D23-member night on September 27 remain available; eligibility and stock can change.
The party has 33 dates, August 18 through October 31. The future dates as of September 26 are September 27 and 29; October 1, 4, 6, 8, 11, 13, 15, 18, 20, 22, 25, 27, 29 and 31.
The published date prices were $139–$199, with October 31 at $199. A posted historical price does not mean a ticket is available now.
Use Disney’s event page for current ticket status, entertainment times and any changes before making travel commitments.

strategy.heading: Which night to pick, and why early beats late
body: The published 2026 calendar is mostly Sundays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, with Saturday, October 31 as the final party night. September 27 is reserved for D23 members and their guests.

Ticket prices are date-based, from $139 on some early nights to $199 on October 31. With general tickets sold out, select a night from a ticket you already hold rather than planning around a theoretical price.
The event has limited capacity, but individual waits and character appearances vary. Check the Disneyland app on the day for the current event guide.

strategy.heading: The three hours before the party are free real estate
body: Your valid event ticket admits you to Disney California Adventure at 3:00 p.m., three hours before the 6:00 p.m. party begins. No separate park reservation is needed for entry at 3:00 p.m. or later.

Use the pre-party hours for regular daytime offerings, then decide which party-only experiences matter most once the event begins. Ride and character waits vary; check the Disneyland app rather than assuming a fixed queue pattern.

The pattern reverses again in the last 90 minutes. Families with young children leave, the treat trails empty, and the villain queues shorten sharply. If there is one meet you badly want and the line was 60 minutes at eight, check it again at ten.

Eat before the party starts or after nine. The first two hours of the event are when every quick-service line in the park is at its worst, because that is the hour the entire party population discovers it has not had dinner.

strategy.heading: Working the treat trails
body: The treat trails are fixed walk-through routes with candy stations along them, and they are worth doing once each rather than repeatedly. The candy is ordinary; the trails are decorated and themed, and that is the reason to walk them.

Bring your own tote. The bag handed out at the entrance is small and the trails are generous, and the people carrying a folded shopping bag in a pocket are not the ones repacking on a bench at nine in the evening.

Disney says Cast Members at each treat trail can offer alternative options for guests seeking allergy-friendly or no-sugar-added treats. Ask at the trail rather than assuming a particular candy is safe for your dietary needs.

The trails toward the back of the park clear out first, usually by about nine. The ones near the entrance stay busy until close, because that is where guests who arrive late start. Walk the park backwards: start at the far end and finish near the gate.

strategy.heading: What to do with the rest of the day
body: A party ticket costs you the evening of a regular park day, so the day around it needs planning. The efficient pattern is a Disneyland Park morning on a separate regular ticket, a genuine hotel break in the early afternoon, then Disney California Adventure on the party ticket from mid-afternoon.

That break matters more than it sounds. The party runs to eleven at night, the best part of it is the last two hours, and a family that has been on their feet since eight in the morning does not make it that far.

Disney allows costumes at this event subject to its detailed rules. Guests ages 14 and older may not wear masks except for medical purposes; some masks are allowed for ages 13 and under if eyes remain visible. Avoid realistic weapons and costumes that drag.

Photographs are the one thing worth pre-planning. The villain meets have dedicated backdrops and PhotoPass photographers, and the queue length is the entire cost. Pick the three characters your group actually cares about and accept that you will not get all of them.

strategy.heading: Do DCA on a party day, and be gone by six
body: Disney California Adventure closes to regular day guests at 6:00 p.m. on Bash nights. Check the official daily hours before booking a regular DCA ticket for the same date.

One trap worth naming: the 15:00–18:00 mix-in window is the park’s busiest stretch of the day, because regular guests and arriving party guests share the park at once. If you are riding on a day ticket, ride in the morning and treat late afternoon as departure time.
Select rides may operate during the party, and waits vary by date and hour. The Disneyland app is the reliable source for current waits and entertainment times.

faqs.q: Is Oogie Boogie Bash at Disneyland Park or Disney California Adventure?
faqs.a: Disney California Adventure only. The 2026 party, treat trails, Villains Grove and Madame Leota’s street party are there; the Bash ticket does not admit you to Disneyland Park.

faqs.q: Does Oogie Boogie Bash sell out?
faqs.a: Yes. Disney currently states that 2026 general admission is sold out. Its event page says tickets for the September 27 D23-member night remain available as of September 26, subject to change.

faqs.q: How much does Oogie Boogie Bash cost?
faqs.a: Disney’s published 2026 date prices run from $139 to $199 per guest ages 3 and up, with October 31 at $199. General admission is sold out as of September 26, so these prices are the event’s published list, not a statement of current availability.

faqs.q: Does the ticket include Disneyland Park or the rest of the day?
faqs.a: The Bash ticket admits you to Disney California Adventure from 3:00 p.m. through the 11:00 p.m. party end on its valid date. It does not include Disneyland Park. Disney says no separate park reservation is needed for DCA entry at 3:00 p.m. or later.

faqs.q: Can adults wear costumes to Oogie Boogie Bash?
faqs.a: Yes, subject to Disney’s event costume guidelines. Guests 14 and older may not wear masks except for medical purposes; some masks are permitted for children 13 and under if eyes remain visible. Costumes may not drag or include realistic weapons.

faqs.q: Is Lightning Lane sold for the party?
faqs.a: No. Disney says Lightning Lane Multi Pass, Premier Pass and Single Pass are not available during Oogie Boogie Bash event hours.

faqs.q: Is it worth going if the only date I can get is in late October?
faqs.a: Only if you already hold a valid ticket. General admission is sold out as of September 26, 2026. For ticket holders, the same five-hour event and 3:00 p.m. early entry apply on late-October nights; check Disney’s app for the day’s schedule.

faqs.q: Are the 2026 dates and ticket status confirmed?
faqs.a: Yes. Disney published 33 event dates from August 18 through October 31, 2026, and currently says general admission is sold out. It identifies September 27 as a D23-member night with tickets still available as of September 26. Event details and availability can change.

changes: The full run sold out in advance, continuing a pattern that has held every year since the event returned in 2021.
Pricing spread further across the calendar than in earlier seasons, with a wider gap between the cheapest early-season weeknights and the last October dates.
Magic Key holders again received an earlier purchase window, and the most in-demand dates did not survive it in quantity.
